{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data and deduplicate as before
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Filter for the treatment arm only
treatment_df = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Check the distribution of severity in the treatment arm
treatment_severity = treatment_df['severity'].value_counts(normalize=True)

# Check the distribution of severity in the control arm
treatment_df = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'control']
control_severity = treatment_df['severity'].value_counts(normalize=True)

print("Severity distribution in treatment arm:")
print(treatment_severity)
print("\nSeverity distribution in control arm:")
print(control_severity)"}
